title: koyamacalia pilgeriana
intro: Koyamacalia pilgeriana, commonly known as the Himalayan yam or Himalayan arrowroot, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Compositae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and pain, as well as aiding in the treatment of skin conditions and wounds. The health benefits of Koyamacalia pilgeriana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
